title: Data model for an ISLOPOL product model
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a product or material model that defines shared characteristics for individual Product records in the ISLOPOL value chain, covering its name, constituents, material, available categories and default unit of measurement.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:ProductModel:<modelId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be ProductModel

name.description: Property. Human-readable name of the product model, used to label products. Given in the source as https://schema.org/name.

refLcaId.description: Property. Reference identifier used for LCA traceability.

description.description: Property. Human-readable description of the product or material represented by the model.

constituents.description: Property. Materials or components making up the product model.

availableCategories.description: Property. List of product categories or grades available for the model. Simple hierarchies are allowed, e.g. 'Waste > EPS'.

material.description: Property. Main material or composition associated with the product model. Given in the source as https://schema.org/material.

quantityUnit.description: Property. UN/CEFACT code of the default unit of measurement for products of this model, e.g. KGM (kilogram), KWH (kilowatt hour) or EA (each).
